title: GAO-23-104661 remains Open with a December 2026 lifecycle-cost forecast
summary: GAO records Recommendation 1 Open as of April 2026, states that no GAO-aligned lifecycle cost estimate existed, and reports NNSA's forecast to establish one in December 2026 after planned SRPPF design completion by fiscal-year end. Denominator: The exact GAO-23-104661 Recommendation 1 identity and April 2026 status update, including the two forecast dates but no assumed completion.
